title: Corner annotation file (annotation_<track>.json)
description: Manually authored, version-controlled per-track corner annotation. All spline positions are AC normalized track-spline values in [0, 1]. Zones may wrap the start/finish line, so start < end is NOT enforced. Consumed by trace-rt (pass tracker, renderer), the reference extractor, and the simulator.

track.description: AC track id (folder name, optionally with layout suffix).

id.description: Stable corner id, e.g. "T1". Referenced by reference tables, pass records, and fade events.

type.description: Corner-type tag (descriptive only; not used by the controller).

compound.description: True for chicanes / linked corners sharing one braking event (one braking zone, possibly multiple apex gates).

braking.description: Zone within which the brake-initiation event is searched for. OPTIONAL: absent on corners taken without braking; such a corner is not in the braking-point element's applicable set (no marker rendered, no braking criterion evaluated, excluded from that element's quorum denominator).

apex_gates.description: Spline position(s) at which the apex evaluation window is centred. More than one only for compound corners.

apex_window_half_m.description: Half-width, in metres of track length, of the spline window centred on each apex gate over which RMS lateral deviation from the expert line is taken (framing v6: never a single-point sample at the gate, which is noisy and gameable). Metres rather than spline units so the value is track-length independent; the runtime and the extractor convert with the AI-spline track length. Default 20.0 (impl plan section 7), reviewed per corner at Gate G0. The maximum is a typo guard: a half-width above 100 m would swallow whole neighbouring corners.

corner_speed.description: Zone over which minimum corner speed is taken.
